annotations.exact_quote: Hyperspectral Image Classification via Sparse Representation With Incremental Dictionaries
annotations.reason_zh: 标题明确以高光谱图像分类为研究对象，HSI为应用对象。
标题和摘要均以稀疏表示（SR）为核心方法，并学习增量字典提升表示能力。

annotations.exact_quote: by exploiting unlabeled pixels with spatial information and multiple-feature-based SR classifiers, we select and add some of them to dictionaries in an iterative manner

annotations.exact_quote: we select and add some of them to dictionaries in an iterative manner
